name: Hangxiao Steel Structure Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangxiao Steel Structure Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the steel structure business in China and internationally. It offers steel structural components and building panels; and integrated buildings system solutions, including technical consulting, engineering design, scheme customization, manufacturing, and installation. The company also provides prefabricated building EPC general contracting services for multi-story and high-rise steel structure buildings, light steel structures, spatial steel structure buildings, and steel structure residences; and architectural design.
